title: Rule Breaker's Guide
description: Breaking open Minecraft for those who seek more in survival.
body:
Welcome to the Rule Breaker's Guide. A Minecraft mod which adds recipes for a ton of items and blocks that are unobtainable in vanilla survival, as well as adding other quality of life additions.

It is HIGHLY recommended that you play this mod with a mod such as [Just Enough Items](https://modrinth.com/mod/jei) installed.
